description: This file is a React component for a Todo app using AWS Amplify, including GraphQL queries/mutations, state management with useReducer, and server-side data fetching with getStaticProps.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: Handles state updates for adding, deleting, and setting current Todo items.

methods.name: createToDo
methods.description: Creates a new Todo item, updates state, and calls GraphQL mutation to persist.

methods.name: deleteToDo
methods.description: Deletes a Todo item from state and calls GraphQL mutation to delete from backend.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component rendering Todo list UI and handling user interactions.

methods.name: getStaticProps
methods.description: Fetches initial Todo list data at build time using AWS Amplify GraphQL API.
